rfp_requirements.title: Establish management structure with explicit information security responsibility
rfp_requirements.description: Information security program management must include establishment of a management structure with clear reporting paths and explicit responsibility for information security.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe privileged account controls
rfp_requirements.description: Describe the process of controlling and monitoring the use of privileged and administrative accounts, whether MFA is required for privileged access, and whether end-users have local administrator access.

rfp_requirements.title: Implement audit logging and continuous log review
rfp_requirements.description: Ensure audit logging is implemented and logs are reviewed on a continuous basis.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe standard issued device security configuration
rfp_requirements.description: Describe the standard personnel-issued device security configuration/features (Login Password, anti-malware, Full Disk Encryption, Administrative Privileges, Firewall, Auto-lock, etc.).

rfp_requirements.title: Implement controls for ICS/SCADA/OT risk management
rfp_requirements.description: The organization must implement controls and processes to ensure risks, including risks to human safety, are accounted for and managed in the use of ICS, SCADA, and Operational Technologies.

rfp_requirements.title: Implement Defense-in-Depth Network Security
rfp_requirements.description: Implement defense-in-depth and least privilege strategies for securing the information technology networks operated.

rfp_requirements.title: Report Solicitations by State Officers/Employees
rfp_requirements.description: Vendor shall report in writing forthwith to the New Jersey Office of the Attorney General and the State Ethics Commission any solicitation of fees, gifts, or things of value by any State officer or employee or special State officer or employee.

rfp_requirements.title: Prohibition on Private Business Relationships with State Officers
rfp_requirements.description: No vendor may directly or indirectly undertake any private business, commercial, or entrepreneurial relationship with, or sell any interest in such vendor to, any State officer or employee or special State officer or employee having duties related to State procurement; any such relationships must be

rfp_requirements.title: Monitor NJSTART for Bid Amendments
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder is solely responsible for being knowledgeable of all Bid Amendments and should check the NJSTART "Open Bids" Tab daily.

rfp_requirements.title: Report Contributions During Contract Term
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor is required, on a continuing basis, to report any contributions it makes during the term of the Contract and any extensions at the time such contribution is made.

rfp_requirements.title: Establish Threat Management Communication Protocols
rfp_requirements.description: Establish effective communication protocols and processes to collect and disseminate actionable threat intelligence to manage risk associated with new and emerging threats.

rfp_requirements.title: Implement continuous monitoring program
rfp_requirements.description: The organization implements continuous monitoring practices to establish and maintain situational awareness regarding potential threats to the confidentiality, integrity, availability, privacy, and safety of the organization's information and information systems through timely collection and review

rfp_requirements.title: Describe monitoring, alerting, and logging processes
rfp_requirements.description: Describe the processes and technologies used for monitoring, alerting on, and logging of application, system, network, and security events, including log retention and review.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide additional continuous monitoring information (optional)
rfp_requirements.description: Optionally provide any additional information relative to the continuous monitoring control area.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe vulnerability monitoring of dependencies and third-party libraries
rfp_requirements.description: As applicable, describe how vulnerabilities are monitored in dependencies and third-party libraries or code included in the product/system/application/service.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe protective technologies for web application security
rfp_requirements.description: As applicable, describe the protective technologies (Web Application Firewalls, Proxies, etc.) employed to mitigate web application security risks (e.g., SQLi, XSS, XSRF, etc.).

rfp_requirements.title: Implement security monitoring and auditing of physical access
rfp_requirements.description: Implement security monitoring and auditing of physical access.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain an information security incident response capability
rfp_requirements.description: The organization must maintain an information security incident response capability that includes adequate preparation, detection, analysis, containment, recovery, and reporting activities.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide written report of staffing retention efforts
rfp_requirements.description: If it is not practicable to retain any individual(s), the Contractor should provide a written report to the SCM documenting its best efforts along with recommendation to fulfill staffing requirements.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide monthly written complaint report to SCM
CIF Maintenance Report Format and Content Standards
rfp_requirements.description: The monthly CIF maintenance and repairs report must be delivered to the SCM in electronic format and must be written using the standards, functionality, and scope agreed to by the SCM and the Contractor.

rfp_requirements.title: Mutually Agree Report Format
rfp_requirements.description: The format of the monthly maintenance report shall be mutually agreed upon by the SCM and the Contractor.

rfp_requirements.title: Monthly Capital Report Contents
rfp_requirements.description: Report must list assigned job and WO numbers, facility name/location, date, type, description, cost of each repair, and monthly opening/closing balances.

rfp_requirements.title: Report Sorted by Subcontractor
rfp_requirements.description: First report must list each authorized subcontractor and be sorted by subcontractor's name with back-up billing in same order.

rfp_requirements.title: Report Sorted by Facility
rfp_requirements.description: Second report must be submitted by facility name.

rfp_requirements.title: Respond to audit report with corrective action plan when failure threshold exceeded
Stored transactions and logs available to State
Review server logs
Describe how tasks are performed, monitored, tracked
Automated journal/log for add/change/delete
Archive/store log activities for audit
Detail offsite rotation, cataloging, schedules
Provide report library with purpose/usage
Include job scheduler for reports
Export reports in PDF, Excel, RTF, HTML, plain text
Demonstrate stack isolation if not dedicated hardware
Transfer Files Using State File Transfer Methodology
rfp_requirements.description: All files transferred between Contractor and State system must be transferred securely using the State file transfer methodology.

rfp_requirements.title: Present ERT Menu Options on Repair Website
rfp_requirements.description: Once logged in, ERTs must be presented with menu options including vehicle repair information, change password, update user information, view/modify existing repair information, and other relevant options.

rfp_requirements.title: Bear costs of Breach of Security due to failure to encrypt Personal Data
rfp_requirements.description: If a Breach of Security directly results from Contractor's breach of its contractual obligation to encrypt Personal Data or otherwise prevent its release, Contractor must bear the costs associated with investigation/resolution, required notifications, credit monitoring, toll-free/website/call center

rfp_requirements.title: Designate a Quality Assurance Manager
rfp_requirements.description: Identify and provide a designated Quality Assurance (QA) Manager with similar reporting and communication responsibilities to the SCM; if unavailable, the PM shall act as QA Manager.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide limited ITS access to SCM-approved personnel via Management Console
rfp_requirements.description: Provide limited access to SCM-approved personnel through the Management Console, allowing remote login to enter, view, and/or report all bugs.

rfp_requirements.title: Rank each item category per State standardization guidance
rfp_requirements.description: Identify and rank each item category per State-provided standardization guidance for ITS reporting.

rfp_requirements.title: Immediately correct catalog deviations
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must immediately correct any identified deviation from the Contract in the catalog.

rfp_requirements.title: Remit 1% Procurement Efficiency Program Fee
rfp_requirements.description: For all purchases made under this Contract that have been invoiced, remit a Procurement Efficiency Program Fee in the amount of one percent (1%) of all Purchases to Periscope, acting on behalf of the State of New Jersey.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain sufficient parts at distribution points and service HQ
Employ trained mechanics available within 48 hours
Immediately replace rejected material during warranty period
Perform all services in strict accordance with specifications
Obtain consent before using State name/seal/logos in advertising
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must not use the State's name, seal, or logos in commercial advertising without prior written consent of the NJ Secretary of State.

rfp_requirements.title: Acknowledge State Ownership of Work Product/Deliverables
rfp_requirements.description: The State owns all Deliverables developed for the State in the course of providing Services under the Contract, including all data, materials, reports, plans, drawings, and documents regardless of state of completion.

rfp_requirements.title: Document hours/work for time and materials contracts
rfp_requirements.description: For time and materials contracts, the State Contract Manager must monitor and approve hours of work and work accomplished; payment shall not be made without such documentation.

rfp_requirements.title: Store data per approved project plan and topology
rfp_requirements.description: All State data must be stored, processed, and maintained solely in accordance with a project plan and system topology approved by the State Contract Manager.

rfp_requirements.title: Establish physical and logical access controls
rfp_requirements.description: Establish physical and logical access controls for mobile devices.

rfp_requirements.title: Implement asset management controls
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must implement administrative, technical, and physical controls necessary to safeguard IT assets from threats to confidentiality, integrity, or availability, whether internal/external or deliberate/accidental.

rfp_requirements.title: Prohibition on procuring covered telecommunications equipment/services
rfp_requirements.description: Do not obligate or expend contract funds to enter into, extend, or renew a contract to procure equipment, services, or systems using covered telecommunications equipment or services (Huawei, ZTE, and subsidiaries/affiliates) as a substantial or essential component or critical technology.

rfp_requirements.title: Prohibition on Hytera, Hikvision, and Dahua video surveillance/telecom equipment
rfp_requirements.description: Do not procure video surveillance and telecommunications equipment produced by Hytera Communications, Hangzhou Hikvision Digital Technology, or Dahua Technology (or any subsidiary or affiliate) for public safety, security of government facilities, physical security surveillance of critical infrastru

rfp_requirements.title: Report Clean Air Act violations to the State
rfp_requirements.description: Report each Clean Air Act violation to the State, which will report it to FEMA and the appropriate EPA Regional Office.

rfp_requirements.title: Report Water Pollution Control Act violations to the State
rfp_requirements.description: Report each Federal Water Pollution Control Act violation to the State, which will report it to FEMA and the appropriate EPA Regional Office.

rfp_requirements.title: Breach of Security definition per N.J.S.A. 56:8-161
rfp_requirements.description: Definition of 'Breach of Security' per N.J.S.A. 56:8-161 — unauthorized access to electronic files, media, or data containing Personal Data that compromises security, confidentiality, or integrity where data is not encrypted or otherwise rendered unreadable. Good faith acquisition by an employee/age

rfp_requirements.title: Report Security Incidents within 24 hours
rfp_requirements.description: Once the Contractor reasonably determines a Security Incident occurred, it must report it to the State-identified contact within 24 hours by the agreed-upon method.

rfp_requirements.title: Secure Data Disposal per NIST
rfp_requirements.description: When requested by the State, Contractor must destroy all requested data in all forms (disk, CD/DVD, backup tape, paper) permanently and non-recoverably using NIST-approved methods.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide security logs and reports
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide logs and reports to the State in agreed format, including latency statistics, user access, user access IP address, user access history and security logs for all State Data.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain logs and reports for contract term plus 2 years
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must maintain reports and logs for the contract term and two (2) years after conclusion and provide them to the State during audits or upon written request.

rfp_requirements.title: Annual independent data center audit
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must have an independent third-party audit of its data center(s) performed at least annually at its own expense and provide the audit report to the State upon request.

rfp_requirements.title: Bear costs of Breach from encryption failure
rfp_requirements.description: Where a Breach of Security is a direct result of Contractor's breach of its obligation to encrypt Personal Data, Contractor must bear costs of investigation/resolution, notifications, credit monitoring, website/toll-free number/call center, and corrective actions.

rfp_requirements.title: Report absences in accordance with sick leave policy
rfp_requirements.description: Employees must report absences as required; failure to do so or abuse of sick leave privileges may result in discipline.

rfp_requirements.title: Monitor posted bargaining unit vacancies
rfp_requirements.description: Bargaining unit vacancies will be posted at each location; it is the Employee's responsibility to monitor postings and the status of their transfer requests.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide parking at closest station for ERTs
rfp_requirements.description: Equipment Repair Technicians unable to park Company vehicles at their residence shall be provided parking at the closest station; Employee is responsible to report to assigned location by assigned start time.

rfp_requirements.title: Submissions deemed confidential under OPRA and Domestic Security Preparedness Act
rfp_requirements.description: All non-public information submitted as part of a completed Third-Party Information Security Questionnaire, including supporting documents, records, notes, written comments, reports, or analysis, shall be treated as confidential and exempt from public disclosure under N.J.S.A. 47:1A-1 et seq. (OPRA)

rfp_requirements.title: Conform to NJ VIIS Reporting System Specification Version 0.2
rfp_requirements.description: All reporting system implementations must conform to the New Jersey VIIS-Reporting System Specification Document, Version 0.2, dated June 19, 2009.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit notice of intent and option report to the Legislature
rfp_requirements.description: The State Treasurer must submit to the Legislature the notice of intent along with a report describing the option chosen, including an economic analysis of the three options with respect to the operation/maintenance portion of the contract.

rfp_requirements.title: Immediately report changes to source disclosure information
rfp_requirements.description: Any changes to the information set forth in the Source Disclosure Form during the term of any Contract or extension shall be immediately reported by the Contractor to the Director of the Division of Purchase and Property.

Program continuously work with systems and network administrators to improve the VIID environment’s cybersecurity
and mitigate threats. Since Parsons has a full cybersecurity practice, the vehicle inspection security staff has an arsenal

security service includes products and methods for antivirus and malware controls, firewall control process and intrusion

compliant, on-time delivery with no disruptions or negative customer impacts.
